format_check_setting_formatter: The instance {tool} must set formatter to one of {allowed}; it has "{value}".
format_check_missing: {formatter} is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
format_check_probe_failed: {formatter} at {path} did not answer its version query.
format_check_no_manifest: No {file} was found in the component, so cargo fmt has no crate to check.
format_check_blocked: The format check could not run: {detail}
format_check_exit_error: {tool} ended with code {code} without a result JGates can read: {detail}
format_check_timeout: The format check exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
format_check_cancelled: The run was cancelled; the formatter was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
format_check_no_invocation: The plan has no format-check invocation for the instance {tool}.
format_check_finding: {tool} would reformat this file ({edits, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}). Run the formatter in write mode to fix it.
format_check_reason_completed: {tool} {version}: {count, plural, one {# file would be reformatted} other {# files would be reformatted}}
format_check_condition_check_only: Check mode only: the formatter lists the files it would change and rewrites nothing.
format_check_limitation_ruff: ruff format --check with the [tool.ruff] settings of the project; files ignored by .gitignore are not checked.
format_check_limitation_prettier: prettier --check with the project's configuration; .prettierignore and .gitignore decide which files count.
format_check_limitation_gofmt: gofmt -l lists the files whose formatting differs; gofmt has no options of its own.
format_check_limitation_rustfmt: cargo fmt --check formats the crate of the component with the project's rustfmt.toml.
format_check_limitation_dotnet: dotnet format whitespace only (the rules of the project's .editorconfig); style and analyzer rules need a build and are not checked.
